resources.string: Third-party viewer for zdeer / UDU otoscope cameras. Video is processed on this device only.
Join “zdeer earpick-*” in system Wi-Fi first. Android does not let the app switch networks silently.
On Android 17+, allow “Nearby devices” so the app can reach the camera on the local network.
The camera hotspot has no password. Anyone nearby can join it and view the same stream — use it somewhere private.
Skip the hotspot and stream from a custom UDP endpoint. Useful with the fake device.
Enter a valid host and port (1–65535).
The hotspot is connected. Heartbeats are being sent; video starts when the camera answers.
No replies yet. Confirm the phone is on the camera hotspot and Android 17 has Nearby devices allowed. If another client was streaming, power-cycle the camera.
The camera answers commands but sends no video. Close the official app or any other client, power-cycle the camera, then retry.
